history.summary: Integrated mixed-use 1BR atop Bukit Panjang MRT/LRT and Hillion Mall, priced at $1,730 psf (just under the $1,754 median) on a liquid 144-txn base. Excellent transit/retail connectivity and low $820K entry, but a soft 2.7%/yr 99LH appreciation and niche 1BR segment make it Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: $820K entry with on-site MRT/LRT interchange and Hillion Mall is a genuinely convenient, lettable asset, and PSF $1,730 is fair against the $1,754 median on a deep 144-txn series. But 99LH appreciation is just 2.7%/yr, the weak arena record (81-205-29, Elo 953) reflects a thin-upside profile, and 474 sqft 1BR appeals only to singles/investors.
catalysts: On-site Bukit Panjang MRT (DTL) + LRT interchange and Hillion Mall
Low $820K entry quantum keeps it lettable and liquid
